design.act: build the site-function classification (Asset B) as cited data on the Spec 027 gazetteer spine inside step 1, freeze it by digest, extract and freeze the ledger-sign list from Roif's two Academia.edu postings of record, then run the distribution test of spec section 6 under criteria frozen before any site is classified or any inscription is counted

claim_under_test.record: Phase-104 evaluation: verdict stays_untested, rule RULE-SITE - the falsification condition requires site-typology data and no such dataset exists in the repository

asset_b.universe: the 30 program_site_id clusters of the pinned gazetteer (36 source-assertion rows); one asset row per cluster; corpus sites outside the spine are outside the asset by rule
asset_b.mixed_unknown: belongs to neither grouping and never enters the primary test
asset_b.agreement_rule: two independent published sources (spec section 4.3 defines independence), each mapped on its own statement first with citation and locator, mapping to the identical class, make a row AGREED; a row is testable iff AGREED with a class other than mixed/unknown; a citation-verification pass precedes the asset freeze
asset_b.no_tiebreak: no third source is sought, no majority rule applies, and no worker adjudicates between sources; disagreement is a recorded property of the literature
asset_b.circularity: no class, mapping, or status is derived from inscription content, sign distributions, or per-site inscription counts; the build does not consult the primary layer's per-site counts; a dated attestation naming the worker is part of the build record
asset_b.freeze_point: inside step 1, before any step-2 counting and before any consumer reads a class for a test; the SHA-256 digest over the committed file bytes is recorded with the row count, the testable count, and the per-status counts
asset_b.dependents: the D-10 specification pins Asset B by this digest in its own inputs and re-asserts it at its step 0 (campaign R-2); a mismatch stops the consumer as INVALID
asset_b.unsound_rule: any later change to a row's status or class makes the frozen asset unsound: the campaign cluster tripwire fires, this spec and its dependents close as not-run, and a corrected asset requires a successor spec; post-freeze changes are dated append-only errata that change no status or class

build_gates.B1: coverage: exactly 30 rows, one per spine cluster
build_gates.B2: citation completeness for every row's status
build_gates.B3: the citation-verification pass for every AGREED row

asset_b.thinness: DD-047-1 (confirmed at the freeze): the number of testable sites is not a build gate; a honestly built thin asset freezes, and its thinness is adjudicated by the section 6.3 classification gate

ledger_sign_list.source: Roif's two Academia.edu postings of record (spec section 2.1) and nothing else - not the hypothesis-model file, not Phase-147, not any summary (DD-047-3)
ledger_sign_list.rule: a depicted sign or sign class enters only if Roif's text explicitly assigns it an economic function; each entry records the sign, the assigned function, a locator in the posting, and the mapped sign identifiers through the pinned crosswalk
ledger_sign_list.unmapped: entries that cannot be mapped are recorded UNMAPPED and excluded from counting by rule; the extraction census is published with the outcome
ledger_sign_list.freeze: in the same step-1 freeze act as Asset B, under its own SHA-256 digest
ledger_sign_list.all_unmapped: DD-047-13: if no entry maps, the execution proceeds on measure (a) alone under the amended partition in the frozen test record; the vacated ledger clause is stated openly in the outcome record

step0_gates.input_integrity: gate 0.1: every section 2 input hashes to its freeze-record value; a mismatch stops the run as INVALID
step0_gates.spine_reproduction: gate 0.2: the pinned gazetteer reproduces exactly (36 rows, 30 clusters, the frozen cluster list); a mismatch stops the run as INVALID
step0_gates.join_census: gate 0.3: every primary-layer record is accounted for in exactly one of joined, non-spine site (listed with counts), or no site value; a record in no class or two stops the run as INVALID

test.population: testable sites carrying at least one joined inscription in the primary layer; testable sites with no joined inscription are listed NO-CORPUS-COVERAGE and enter neither share
test.join: mechanical site-name normalisation (lowercase, whitespace and punctuation collapsed) against the gazetteer cluster names; no fuzzy matching and no hand assignment

measures.inscription_share_R: the pooled class's share of all inscriptions at test-population sites divided by the pooled class's share of test-population sites
measures.ledger_sign_share_R_ledger: the same ratio over occurrences of the section 5 ledger signs pooled, with per-sign counts reported alongside

permutation.seed_dd: DD-047-10 (fixed at the freeze, before any count exists)

classification_gate.empty_side: DD-047-2 (confirmed at the freeze): an empty pooled or contrast side in the test population fires the same gate
classification_gate.outcome: INCONCLUSIVE - the classification is the finding, reported with its full disagreement list; no distribution quantity is computed

criteria.not_supported: R <= 1.0, or the permutation test does not reject (p >= 0.05)
criteria.inconclusive: every remaining case: 1.0 < R < 1.5, or R >= 1.5 with p < 0.05 but R_ledger <= 1.0

test.all_unmapped_partition: DD-047-13: if no ledger entry maps, R_ledger is not computed: SUPPORTED iff R >= 1.5 and p < 0.05; NOT SUPPORTED iff R <= 1.0 or p >= 0.05; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise; the vacated ledger clause is stated openly in the outcome record
test.sensitivities: each source alone, and the five largest sites; reported beside the primary, never verdict-changing
test.second_corpus_layer: DD-047-9: unused - the pinned primary layer is the sole verdict-bearing corpus
test.d10_against_thin_asset: DD-047-11: D-10 proceeds under its own gates against a frozen-but-thin Asset B; it closes not-run only if the asset fails to build or is found unsound
test.classification_audit: DD-047-14: the section 4.3 verification pass suffices; no separate audit is required, and its record is published in the step-1 outcome

design.roif_gate: campaign R-7: this spec's records are internal; nothing derived from its results is surfaced on any public surface; campaign reporting names this member only as 'executed - held under the Roif gate', with no result content; publication of results is the owner's separate GATE act, with the section 2.1 citations carried in the published text; the OSF registration filed at this freeze carries the frozen contract (a design text) only and clears nothing under the gate
design.fences: the Phase-104 record stands unedited and this spec's outcome appends to the claim's record as a dated entry; Phase-147 is not evidence for or against the distribution component; the anchors file is asserted byte-identical before and after any execution; Spec 039's period-assignment product is not an input - a period label is not a site function
design.execution_gate: Not satisfied at the freeze of 2026-10-21: execution runs as Phase-406 only after this freeze has merged, the OSF contract registration's approval act has completed (the parent's approval click on OSF's admin notification), and a separate execution order is given; no site was classified, no ledger-sign list was extracted, and nothing was counted at the freeze itself
